name: get_fact
description: Return the current resolved fact for (tenant_id, subject, predicate): value, status, winning_event_id, policy_version, resolution_reason, validity window. Tenant-scoped; no free-form SQL. Use explain_fact for the full provenance. tenant_id must equal the caller's identity claim.

tenant_id.description: Tenant. Must equal the caller's verified tenant_id claim (enforced by Cedar).

subject.description: The subject/entity key the fact is about.
